registry.name: W4VE
registry.description: Tools for technical Minecraft servers that do not break vanilla.

architectury-api.name: Architectury API
architectury-api.summary: Compatibility layer that multiplatform mods build against.

axiom.name: Axiom
axiom.summary: All-in-one world editing tool, with a server half so a whole build team can use it.

beaconator.name: Beaconator
beaconator.summary: Plan beacon perimeters: ring grid from one point, real coverage volumes, and beams where beacons are still missing.
beaconator.blurb: Plan a beacon perimeter before you place a single beacon: ring grid from one point, real coverage volumes, and beams shooting up where a beacon is still missing.

beep.name: Beep
beep.summary: Plays a sound to a player who is being talked to, so nobody misses a message.

bluemap.name: BlueMap
bluemap.summary: Builds a 3D model of the world and serves it as a web map.

botinventory-carpet.name: BotInventory
botinventory-carpet.summary: View and manage fake player inventories and ender chests by right-click or command. Carpet addon.
botinventory-carpet.blurb: View and manage fake player inventories and ender chests by right-click or command, without stopping the farm.

buildevents.name: Build Events
buildevents.summary: Tracks block placements and breaks inside an area, for build events.

carpet.name: Carpet
carpet.summary: The technical player's toolbox: fake players, tick control, hundreds of rules.

carpet-ams-addition.name: Carpet AMS Addition
carpet-ams-addition.summary: Carpet extension from AMS with extra rules and tools for technical play.

carpet-extra.name: Carpet Extra
carpet-extra.summary: Extra Carpet rules that did not fit in the base mod.

carpet-tis-addition.name: Carpet TIS Addition

conflicts.why: Fabric refuses to boot: incompatible mods found

carpet-tis-addition.summary: TIS Union's Carpet addon: extra tools and fixes for technical servers.

chatbridge.name: ChatBridge
chatbridge.summary: Chat bridge between Minecraft servers and Discord, with full-body avatars, per-player mute and cross-server emotes.
chatbridge.blurb: Discord and Minecraft chat bridge: MC players show up as themselves in Discord, with per-player mute and cross-server emotes.

chunk-debug.name: ChunkDebug
chunk-debug.summary: Live map of chunk loading states in any dimension. Both sides needed.

command-suggest.name: CommandSuggest
command-suggest.summary: Suggests the right command when someone gets it slightly wrong.

daycount-nbt.name: DayCountNBT
daycount-nbt.summary: Reads the world day count straight from the NBT, so it survives restarts and resets.

deepslate-instamine.name: Deepslate Instamine
deepslate-instamine.summary: Instamines deepslate with an Efficiency V netherite pickaxe and Haste II.

digall.name: DigAll
digall.summary: Real grand total of blocks mined for DiggyScoreboard, including offline and historical players, bots excluded.
digall.blurb: A real grand total of blocks mined for [DiggyScoreboard](https://github.com/Fallen-Breath/DiggyScoreboard), counting offline and historical players too, bots excluded.

discord-todo-board.name: Discord To-Do Board
discord-todo-board.summary: Self-hosted Discord bot: a live project board in a channel, all buttons. One or many boards, optional HTTP webhook.
discord-todo-board.blurb: A live project board inside a Discord channel, all buttons, no web app. One board or many, optional HTTP webhook.

essentialaddons.name: EssentialAddons
essentialaddons.summary: Carpet extension with admin and creative tools, many ported from the Essentials plugin.

fabric-api.name: Fabric API
fabric-api.summary: Core hooks nearly every Fabric mod needs.

fabric-language-kotlin.name: Fabric Language Kotlin
fabric-language-kotlin.summary: Runtime for Fabric mods written in Kotlin. Several mods here need it.

fabricproxy-lite.name: FabricProxy-Lite
fabricproxy-lite.summary: Forwards player data from a Velocity proxy, so a server behind one keeps real identities.

ferritecore.name: FerriteCore
ferritecore.summary: Cuts memory usage without changing any behaviour.

g4mespeed.name: G4mespeed
g4mespeed.summary: Changes tick rate reliably and keeps client and server in step.

gooderrails.name: Gooder Rails
gooderrails.summary: Server-side port of the better rail placements from MendedMinecarts.

here.name: Here
here.summary: Broadcasts where you are, with a clickable waypoint for the people who ask every five minutes.

intricarpet.name: Intricarpet
intricarpet.summary: Carpet extension aimed at TNT tech.

invview.name: Inv View
invview.summary: Open and edit inventories and ender chests of online and offline players.

joacarpet.name: JoaCarpet
joacarpet.summary: Small Carpet extension for redstone and storage tech, plus a few survival tweaks.

krypton.name: Krypton
krypton.summary: Optimises the networking stack, which is what a server with many players spends its time on.

litematica.name: Litematica
litematica.summary: Schematic placement and printing, the standard building tool.

litematica-server-paster.name: Litematica Server Paster
litematica-server-paster.summary: Lets Litematica paste block and entity data on a server.

lithium.name: Lithium

conflicts.why: Fabric refuses to boot: incompatible mods found

lithium.summary: Server optimisation that keeps vanilla behaviour intact.

malilib.name: MaLiLib
malilib.summary: Shared library for Litematica, MiniHUD and Tweakeroo.

manke.name: Manke
manke.summary: The Discord bot that runs MineWave. Public so you can read it, not packaged for you to install.
manke.blurb: MineWave's own **Discord bot**: chat bridge, stats dashboards, roles, logs and more. Powered by monkeys, for monkeys. 🐒 Public to read, not packaged to install.

mankedomath.name: MankeDoMath
mankedomath.summary: A calculator inside the game: quick maths in chat, with Minecraft units like stacks, shulkers and ticks.
mankedomath.blurb: A calculator that **knows what a shulker box is**. Farm rates, item counts and timings without leaving the game, with stacks, shulker boxes, ticks and chunks as real units: `5sb / 2h` works out to items per hour on its own.

mankelist.name: MankeList
mankelist.summary: Material list for a build: /ml plus a HUD overlay, and an optional Discord board that tracks progress.
mankelist.blurb: Material list for whatever you are building: `/ml`, a HUD overlay, and an optional Discord board that tracks what is still missing.

mcdreforged.name: MCDReforged
mcdreforged.summary: Python server wrapper with hot-reloadable plugins. PyW4VE stays compatible with its plugins.

minecraft-data-api.name: MinecraftDataAPI
minecraft-data-api.summary: Reads player data and NBT from the server for other MCDR plugins.

minimap-sync.name: MinimapSync
minimap-sync.summary: Server-side waypoint sync for Xaero's Minimap, kept compatible with current Xaero releases.
minimap-sync.blurb: Server-side waypoint sync for Xaero's Minimap, kept working on current Xaero releases instead of crashing them.

multi-rcon-api.name: MultiRconAPI
multi-rcon-api.summary: Talks RCON to several servers at once. What cross-server commands are built on.

online.name: Online
online.summary: Lists who is online across every server in the network, not just this one.

pca-protocol.name: pca-protocol
pca-protocol.summary: Server half of the PCA protocol, so clients can inspect containers and entities remotely.

primebackup.name: PrimeBackup
primebackup.summary: Backup plugin with deduplication. This fork restores the clickable command buttons that 1.20.5+ clients silently ignore.
primebackup.blurb: Deduplicated backups for MCDR. This fork brings back the clickable command buttons that 1.20.5+ clients silently ignore.

rconhush.name: RconHush
rconhush.summary: Keeps RCON command output out of the server log and out of chat.

redstone-multimeter.name: Redstone Multimeter
redstone-multimeter.summary: Measures redstone timing tick by tick. Needed on both sides.

regioncast.name: RegionCast
regioncast.summary: Pull region files from another server's world into this one, picked off a map. Single chunks too, and recent updates stay undoable.
regioncast.blurb: Pull **region files** from another server's world into this one, picked off a map where one tile is one region. Single chunks too, when a whole region is more than you wanted, and the last few updates stay undoable.

ripdeepslate.name: RipDeepslate
ripdeepslate.summary: Deepslate mines exactly like stone with a netherite pickaxe. Single jar, no dependencies.
ripdeepslate.blurb: Deepslate mines **exactly like stone** with a netherite pickaxe, instant with Efficiency V + Haste II. No ghost blocks, no crack animation.

scalablelux.name: ScalableLux
scalablelux.summary: Starlight-based light engine that makes light updates cheap.

schem-converter.name: Schem Converter
schem-converter.summary: Discord bot that converts .litematic files between NBT versions 4, 5, 6 and 7.
schem-converter.blurb: Converts `.litematic` files between NBT versions 4, 5, 6 and 7, so old schematics open in newer Litematica and the other way round.

server-replay.name: ServerReplay
server-replay.summary: Records replays server-side, for Replay Mod or Flashback, without anyone running a client.

server-waypoint.name: Server Waypoint
server-waypoint.summary: Server-side waypoints that sync themselves into Xaero's Minimap.

servux.name: Servux
servux.summary: Serves structure and entity data to Litematica and friends.

shapeboard.name: ShapeBoard
shapeboard.summary: Scoreboards for areas of any shape: outline it with blocks in the sky, count digs and placements inside, per-player sidebar.
shapeboard.blurb: Scoreboards for areas of **any shape**, not just boxes. Outline the zone with blocks in the sky, every block broken or placed inside counts, and a per-player sidebar leaderboard appears when you walk in.

shulkerfix.name: ShulkerFix
shulkerfix.summary: Stops shulker bullets from breaking armor stands.

spark.name: spark
spark.summary: Profiler for clients, servers and proxies. The first thing to install when something is slow and nobody knows why.

stackdeobf.name: StackDeobfuscator
stackdeobf.summary: Remaps stacktraces in the log to readable names, so a crash report says something.

statshelper.name: StatsHelper
statshelper.summary: Minecraft statistics helper for MCDR, with the MineWave-side fixes.
statshelper.blurb: Minecraft statistics for MCDR, with a UUID and rename de-duplication fix on top of upstream.

styled-chat.name: Styled Chat
styled-chat.summary: Formats server chat with placeholders and per-player styles, no client mod needed.

syncmatica.name: Syncmatica
syncmatica.summary: Shares Litematica schematics and their placements between everyone on the server.

url-preview-api.name: URLPreviewAPI
url-preview-api.summary: Fetches link previews for other plugins to use.

w4ve.name: w4ve
w4ve.summary: One command to install, update and check every piece of the ecosystem. The Python runtime that wraps the server process and keeps MCDR plugins working lands in the same repo.

w4ve-core.name: w4ve-core
w4ve-core.summary: Shared Java library for W4VE mods: config with hot reload, commands, permissions, Discord boards, and the link to PyW4VE.

w4vecarpet.name: W4VECarpet
w4vecarpet.summary: Carpet extension written for MineWave: quick teleport command and a whitelist with zones.

wavemotes.name: WaveMotes
wavemotes.summary: Type :emote: in chat and pick it from a popup. Built-in emote pack rendered client-side, no resource pack needed, plus optional Discord emojis.
wavemotes.blurb: Type `:emote:` in chat, pick from a `/`-style popup. Emotes baked into the jar and rendered client-side, plus optional Discord emojis.

wavemotes-server.name: WaveMotes Server
wavemotes-server.summary: Server half of WaveMotes: resource-pack generator plus chat injector so even vanilla clients see the emotes.
wavemotes-server.blurb: The server side: resource-pack generator and chat injector so **everyone**, even vanilla clients, sees the emotes, bridged to Discord across servers.

where-is.name: WhereIs
where-is.summary: Asks where another player is, with the same waypoint button.

worldeaternotifier.name: WorldEaterNotifier
worldeaternotifier.summary: Watches world eaters, trenchers and bedrock breakers, and pings Discord when one stops or gets stuck.
worldeaternotifier.blurb: Watches world eaters and trenchers and pings **Discord** when one stops or gets obstructed, with per-event ping control so you only get the alerts you want.

worldedit.name: WorldEdit
worldedit.summary: The map editor that runs in-game: selections, schematics, copy and paste, brushes.

xaeros-minimap.name: Xaero's Minimap
xaeros-minimap.summary: Minimap with waypoints. What MinimapSync syncs into.

technical-survival.name: Technical survival server
technical-survival.description: A vanilla-behaviour server for people who build farms and perimeters.

technical-client.name: Technical player client
technical-client.description: What to put in your own instance to play on one of these servers.

minewave.name: MineWave
minewave.description: Exactly what runs on the MineWave survival server. Kept honest: if it is not here, it is not on the server.
